create_MNISTBandit_environment: create an MNISTBandit environment instance with a configurable fraction of training data and random seed
run_MNISTBandit_episode: run an MNISTBandit episode by calling reset then step with a digit classification action
review_MNISTBandit_observation_spec: review the MNISTBandit observation spec which returns a 28x28 float32 image array
review_MNISTBandit_action_spec: review the MNISTBandit action spec which returns a discrete array with 10 possible digit values
summarize_MNISTBandit_bsuite_info: summarize the MNISTBandit bsuite_info method that returns total regret metadata for scoring
